text:
Taylor: hey all, first day! trying to open the model-serving Grafana dashboard but I hit a 403. url: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/q7x-model-rt. who grants access?
Kelsey: welcome Taylor!! :tada: are you signing in via Okta? sometimes the app provision lags.
Taylor: yes via Okta (taylor@redwood.com). browser shows I'm signed in but Grafana immediately 403s.
onboard-bot: Welcome to Redwood! Please fill out the Observability access form: https://go/redwood/obs-access so infra can map your Okta groups.
Kelsey: two quick things: 1) try a hard refresh / incognito to rule out stale SSO cookies; 2) check that your obs-access request includes the exact dashboard UID or folder name. If both are fine it's usually a folder permission.
Taylor: did hard refresh, still 403. filled obs-access (req #9998) and listed Grafana: q7x-model-rt, Datadog: model-service-prod, Sentry: model-service-prod.
Ravi: tagging eng-observability @Kelsey. I can do a manual Okta->Grafana sync. If that doesn't work I can temporarily add you to the grafana-team:observability-readonly group which has Viewer+Comment.
Kelsey: also if you want to grab the error id: open devtools > network > filter '/api/dashboards/uid' and look at the response. paste the errorId here and we can search logs. Example curl to reproduce (will 403):
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" \
  "https://grafana.redwood.internal/api/dashboards/uid/q7x-model-rt"
```
Taylor: network response has {"message":"user not authorized","errorId":"graf-9c1b"}.
Ravi: that errorId means folder-level restriction. I synced Okta groups but the dashboard lives in a restricted folder owned by @maria-models. Maria's in a customer meeting for a few hours; I can bind a 12-hour folder-view role for you to unblock the first-day tasks. Okay to give temporary access?
Taylor: yes please, that would be great.
Kelsey: for Datadog/Sentry, the obs-access ticket covers them too. For Datadog we add people to the org role 'model-readers' and invite to the staging workspace first — staging alerts won't fire production pages.
Ravi: granted folder-view to Taylor for uid q7x-model-rt (12h). try incognito.
Taylor: success! can see panels. thanks so much. Datadog invite still pending per the ticket.
Kelsey: welcome again. If you want to edit visualizations, please fork the dashboard and propose changes; owners approve merges. Also FYI the canonical new-hire dashboards list is at https://go/redwood/observability-dashboards -> "new hires" section.
Taylor: perfect. one last Q: any recommended panels to glance at first for production health?
Kelsey: glance at p99 latency, token throughput, error-rate-by-model, and the "deploy-impact" row to see recent deploys side-by-side with latency spikes.
Taylor: noted, thanks everyone :rocket:
Kelsey: ping here if Datadog/Sentry don't land in 24h and we'll escalate.
thread_text_short: New hire Taylor hits 403 for Grafana dashboard q7x-model-rt; Kelsey and Ravi troubleshoot SSO/folder perms, Ravi grants 12h folder-view, obs-access ticket covers Datadog/Sentry.
